This polynomial has one critical point and invertible Hessian of determinant c^4 for arbitrary Q. Differentiating E xi=0 there forces E to vanish, contradicting the original global slice. Thus (R,f_V)L[v]=L[v].

Hence 1<=deg_v y<=deg q<=2. Combining with the independent constant-projection exclusion leaves deg_v y in{1,2}.
